name: neighbornest
description: NeighborNest — your neighborhood's home services hub (directory + group deals)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run ensure-env && npm --prefix server run db:reset
scripts.dev:server: npm run ensure-env && npm --prefix server run dev
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.seed: npm run ensure-env && npm --prefix server run db:reset
